name: ROAD WORK AHEAD
spec: orange diamond with black legend ROAD WORK AHEAD
meaning: A work zone is ahead; slow down and watch for workers.

snippets.back: A ROAD CONSTRUCTION sign means you are entering a work area, so watch for a flagman, one-way traffic, other signs or obstructions, go carefully and follow instructions.
An orange sign with black letters gives a recommended safe speed for a curve, a grade or another special condition, so slow down until you are sure you can get through safely.
Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols and are used with other devices or flaggers to steer traffic through work areas and protect road workers.
Also watch brake lights ahead, merge early, slide from workers, shun tailgates, honor mobile crews to the End Road Work board, drop distractions, detour when able, and bank extra time calmly.
Work-zone signs, pavement markings and flaggers direct traffic through the work area or a marked detour. Orange warns of road work.
Yellow on a sign warns of hazardous or dangerous conditions and almost always appears on a diamond-shaped sign, while orange warns of road work and appears on rectangular or diamond-shaped signs.
Work zones add arrow boards, temporary signals, flaggers, and channelizing hardware, with mostly diamond-shaped orange signs and only a few rectangles.
Work zones commonly use orange signs, cones, drums, barricades or flashing arrow panels to identify the area.
